title: DecisionTrace.v1
description: WP12: the single immutable trace of the real compiler's actual decisions for one compiled request, in the fixed compiler-sequence order (CLASSIFICATION, PROJECT_TRUST, DISCLOSURE, POLICY, WORKFLOW_SELECTION, CAPABILITY_SELECTION, GRAPH_COMPILATION). Not every stage need appear (compilation may stop early), but any stages present must be unique and in this relative order. No stored entry summary may contain a credential-bearing pattern.

entries.description: One entry per compiler stage actually executed, in fixed compiler-sequence order.

summary.description: Human-readable, non-secret description of the actual decision made at this stage.

reasonCodes.description: Non-empty, stable, uppercase reason codes for this stage's decision.

policyRefs.description: Policy references cited by this stage's decision, if any.
